blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Seven episodes in, “Celeste Unscripted” stops circling and commits. Episode 7, which was released on Goat Creative Studios’ YouTube channel on Sept. 22, ends with Jonathan Sterling holding a diamond, a destination, and a plan. But the scene viewers will replay comes earlier, at Celeste Cortesi’s birthday dinner at L’Opera, when her friend Benj asks everyone at the table to offer one word that describes her. Her friends go first: beautiful, passionate, savior, kind, lovable. Then the British tech entrepreneur takes his turn — and declines to flatter. “I think when people have to give a word, they […]...
